title: •Lars’ Hydroponics Station
caption: Hydroponics Station (V)
game_text: Deploy on a farm. During your draw phase, while no ‘crop’ here, may use 1 Force to stack a ‘crop’ (any one card from Lost Pile) on this device. While you occupy this site, if any just drawn destiny matches destiny of ‘crop’, may place ‘crop’ in your Used Pile.
lore: Grows fruits and vegetables. Very efficient water use. Often underground. Feeds moisture farm families, but excess vegetables are often sold at markets.
